text:
jia: FYI I have a tiny gateway shim that maps old v1/v2 response shapes to the v3 contract for quick client migrations. want quick sanity check on safety and ops controls.
omar: good. is this a full JSON rewrite or key-aliasing?
jia: minimal mapping: alias `choices`->`outputs`, copy `usage` through, and set missing finish_reason to `unknown`. no fabricated content.
lee: streaming support?
jia: initial rollout will only do non-streaming responses. streaming added later behind a flag.
sre-bot: NOTE: include global kill-switch and per-tenant LD flag. add /_compat_health endpoint.
omar: metrics?
jia: compat.shim.invocations, compat.shim.errors, compat.shim.latency.added.p95, compat.shim.field_changes. also 0.1% sampled payload captures (redacted).
lee: security: scrub any keys prefixed with `internal_`. ensure binary blobs are truncated.
ojia: (typo) jia: will do. rollout plan: dogfood 3 days, 5% canary for 48h, then 25% if stable. shim marked temporary in header `X-Compat: v2->v3;expires=2025-09-01`.
omar: perfect. open short RFC and link runbook.
sre-bot: Deploy gated until health+metrics present.
